scope: Isolated real frontend with synthetic tournament and audio; no live announcements.
checks: The text field explains slash completion and history without adding a row to the card
A slash lists players, pairs, clubs and state federations including people without games
Results put state federations first, then clubs, players and pairs
Opening suggestions does not enlarge either top card or move the games
Arrow keys navigate suggestions before history and keep text focus
Up returns to the previous suggestion
Escape dismisses suggestions without changing the draft
Name matching ignores accents and preserves tournament metadata
Enter inserts a full name at the cursor and preserves the rest of the sentence without sending
Tab inserts a pair as spoken names joined with und and retains text focus
A club suggestion replaces only the slash expression
A state search also lists its clubs and players in the requested order
State federation suggestions insert the actual state value
A real mouse selection removes the slash and closes completion
Normal typing after a selected state stays plain text without reopening suggestions
Continuing after a fully typed state removes the slash and preserves the sentence and caret
The reported sentence also normalizes correctly when pasted as a whole
A new slash can independently start another replacement in the same sentence
Repeated replacements leave neither old nor new command slashes in the text
Doubles remain visible when searching both partners with /Gok und Beispiel
Both partner names are inserted without a leftover slash for /Gok und Beispiel
Doubles remain visible when searching both partners with /Göker / Beispiel
Both partner names are inserted without a leftover slash for /Göker / Beispiel
A complete first player does not prematurely discard their possible doubles partner
A fully typed doubles pair finishes before the following normal sentence text
Suggestion labels render imported names as text without interpreting HTML
No results remain explicit and do not replace the draft
Overlong names are disabled instead of truncated
An overlong completion leaves the original text intact
Ordinary slashes and URLs do not open completion
Suggestions fit the viewport without growing the card at 1920
Suggestions fit the viewport without growing the card at 390
Suggestions fit the viewport without growing the card at 320
Only dispatched local and successful remote announcements enter the persistent history
Up recalls the newest sent announcement first
Repeated Up recalls older announcements
History stays at the oldest entry without changing stored texts
Down past the newest entry restores the exact unfinished draft and its selection
Editing a recalled entry creates a new draft without modifying sent history
Modified arrows and composing key events remain available to text editing
Enter outside suggestions keeps normal multiline editing and does not send
Cancelled choices and background waits do not enter sent history
A background wait is not stored before playback dispatch
Background completion records the confirmed text while preserving the new draft
Remote history waits for server confirmation
A rejected remote announcement is not stored as sent
History survives rebuilding the tournament form
History survives page reload in the same browser
A different tournament does not expose the previous tournament history
Fresh completion sources remain available after reload
Removing an open editor also removes its floating suggestions
Completion and history cause no browser exceptions
